SELECT t.`ds_id` AS id, t.`ds_name` AS name, t.`ds_title` as title, t.`ds_desc` AS description, t.db_type as dbType, t.`db_ip` AS dbIp, t.`db_port` AS dbPort, t.`db_name` AS dbName, t.`db_user` AS dbUser, t.`db_password` AS dbPassword, t.`created_by` AS createdBy, t.`updated_by` AS updatedBy, DATE_FORMAT(t.`created_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime, DATE_FORMAT(t.`updated_time`,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedTime, t.db_short_name as dbShortName, t.db_platform as dbPlatform FROM bi_portal.sys_datasource t WHERE 1=1 AND t.`is_active` = 1
and concat(t.db_platform,',') like concat('%',#{type},',%')
